_comment: CANONICAL XAUUSD EXECUTION-COST MODEL. Backtests MUST consume this instead of scenario constants (CLAUDE.md §6 procedural rule 10). All values in PRICE UNITS = USD per troy ounce, directly comparable to a backtest's stop distance. Regenerate with scratchpad/cost_model.py against a verified account.

provenance.WARNING: DEMO ACCOUNT. Demo fill quality is not live fill quality. Spread may be tighter and slippage more benign than a funded account. Treat as an upper bound on execution quality; re-measure before any live promotion.

spread.hourly_note: Flat across all 24 UTC hours: median 0.040-0.050, p95 0.050 everywhere. Only hour 22 UTC differs (median 0.050, p95 0.090). Session effects appear in the at-deal sample, not the raw tick sample.

commission.variance: none observed - constant 0.110 across all 872 entry deals

fees.note: No fee field populated on any of 1913 deals.

swap.note: Zero swap charged because the traded system is intraday and holds nothing overnight. Material for any swing/multi-day rule: longs pay ~0.52 USD/oz/night, shorts pay nothing. Do NOT ignore for overnight strategies.

slippage._definition: deal.price vs order.price_open, sign-corrected so positive is against the trade

stop_loss_triggered_exits.note: SL exits slip ~3x worse at the tail than the general population. This is the single most decision-relevant slippage figure for any stop-based rule.

slippage.limit_orders_note: Limit fills show slightly NEGATIVE mean slippage (price improvement) and essentially no adverse tail. Entry style materially changes cost.

round_trip_model._how_to_use: Do NOT add percentiles across components - they do not co-occur. Use RECOMMENDED_DEFAULT for a single-number backtest, or sample components independently from their distributions for a Monte Carlo cost overlay.

components_mean._exit_blend_note: 402 SL-reason vs 117 TP-reason exits; TP/limit exits ~0 adverse, SL exits mean 0.163

scenario_constants_used_before_2026_09_0.verdict: TOO PESSIMISTIC BY ~2.3x AT THE MEAN. Sits near the p90-p95 of measured cost, not a base case. Conclusions that depended on it must be re-checked - see xauusd-execution-costs.md.
